story.title: Christmas lights bring families to Texas Motor Speedway
story.summary: Gift of Lights at Texas Motor Speedway opened Thursday night and runs through Jan. 3. Dan Ferguson used to hate Christmas. Years of working in retail will do that, he said. Now, he's spending Thanksgiving night enjoying the lights at Texas Motor Speedway. A plate of leftovers along for the ride. "I used to work retail. Hated Christmas all those years," Ferguson said. "Now that I don't. I love it." Ferguson was among the visitors celebrating the season at Gift of Lights, a drive-through display featuring 3 million lights along a two-mile stretch at the speedway. The displays include holiday favorites, with a nod to the speedway's normal attendees. "We have 12 Days of Christmas, we have race cars, we have candy canes, we've got Santa and snowmen and, of course, the Grinch," Lisa Barley, with Gift of Lights, said.
